reviewed_by: Claude review of goal block and intelligence
reason: Three small defects. (1) ChatGoalService.write folded the block action's status check and reason check into one condition, so blocking a paused goal with a reason raised HTTP 422 'blocking a running goal requires a reason', pointing the caller at a reason they had already supplied; the two checks are now separate: a non-running goal raises ConflictError (409, 'only a running goal can be blocked') and a missing reason raises 422. (2) normalize_nvd emitted a VersionRange with every bound None for each cpeMatch, and CorrelationEngine._cpe discarded the advisory CPE's version component, so an advisory whose CPE names one exact version (cpe:2.3:a:apache:http_server:2.4.49:... with no versionStart/End) confirmed ANY observed version at confidence 0.99 because version_in_range passes every check on an unbounded range. normalize_nvd now emits ranges only when NVD set a bound and otherwise versions=[<cpe version>] for a concrete CPE version (nothing for a wildcard); _cpe keeps the advisory CPE's version and requires equality when it is concrete; _range_is_comparable treats an all-None range as no version data, which makes both version_in_range and _has_comparable_version_data refuse to confirm or clear on it. (3) normalize_cve_v5 read problemTypes[].description but the CVE 5 schema key is descriptions, so cwes came back as [''] for every record; it now reads descriptions (falling back to description for older exports), drops entries without a cweId, and de-duplicates. test_chat_goals gains test_block_reports_wrong_status_and_missing_reason_distinctly (fails on main with the 422). test_intelligence gains test_nvd_exact_version_cpe_normalizes_to_a_version_not_an_open_range, test_exact_version_cpe_confirms_only_that_version (2.4.62 is confirmed on main, not_affected now; 2.4.49 stays confirmed), test_exact_version_advisory_cpe_requires_equality_without_range_data, test_unbounded_range_is_not_version_data (version_in_range on VersionRange() is True on main), and test_cve_v5_problem_types_read_descriptions_for_cwe_ids (cwes == ['', '', 'CWE-89'] on main). Both files run in full.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through chat_goals.py and intelligence.py) does not exercise goal blocking from a paused state, NVD/CVE 5 feed normalization, or CPE version correlation; the Python tests drive ChatGoalService, normalize_nvd, normalize_cve_v5 and CorrelationEngine directly. No full suites.
